content:
olivia: Quick sync — partnerships + tooling integrations. Need to lock the LangChain/LlamaIndex adapter checklist for marketplace listing, the gateway signed-URL flow, and who owns HW compatibility tests. Goal: timeline for certification + announcement.

aj: Can we get the SI pilot gating criteria? Also need confirmation on which GPU images vendors will provide for our perf runs.

leo: I'll own the CI compatibility matrix. What sample workloads should we validate? p50/p95 targets? @sana can you share model sizes and token profiles we plan to publish?

sana: For marketplace we'll certify 7B and 13B quantized variants first. Perf SLO suggestion: p95 < 200ms for interactive chat on a single Dedicated A100-equivalent baseline. I'll open a PR with the perf config and token distributions.

olivia: sample test command for the CI jobs (prototype):

```
# local smoke run for adapter
rwd-cli test-adapter --adapter=langchain --model=gptq-13b --image=rw-infer:v2 --batch=dynamic --warmup=200
```

Expect output like:
```
INFO: kv-cache warmup: 200 steps
INFO: throughput=135 tok/s, p95=185ms
```

partners-bot: New HW image received from Nimbus: sha256:abc123... (size: 22G). Upload: s3://partners/nimbus/rw-infer-nimbus-2026-03-20.img

jordan: For the joint announcement I propose a 2-week stagger: 1) marketplace listing + docs, 2) SI pilot kickoff with a customer story, 3) public blog + co-branded webinar. Need marketing + legal signoff before first push.

mia: I'll start logo/asset and legal opt-in forms. Also confirm we need partner NDA addendums for SI pilots?

aj: Yes on NDAs for SI pilots. I'll draft a simple gating doc w/ acceptance criteria: security review complete, perf matrix green, sample workload passed, and SI integration runbook.

leo: Action items: I'll sketch CI matrix (OS, CUDA, image tags, adapter smoke cmds) by EOD Friday. Will attach a small YAML matrix in the PR.

sana: I'll land the perf config PR tomorrow and include the token distributions used for p95 measurement.

olivia: Great — owners: leo (CI matrix), sana (perf PR), aj (SI gating doc), mia (legal/assets). Sync Thursday 11am PT to review. If anyone needs to shift dates, flag here. :calendar: :eyes:

jordan: acked. I can draft the blog timeline after the sync. :+1:

mia: ack, will ping legal and update thread when NDAs cleared. :white_check_mark:

aj: one more ask — do we want to include LlamaIndex-specific connector examples in the marketplace listing (quickstart notebooks)? I can populate two sample cells.

olivia: Yes — include both LangChain and LlamaIndex quickstarts. Keep them tiny: init, load adapter, run query. Example snippet for docs: 

```
from redwood import Adapter
ad = Adapter('langchain')
resp = ad.call('gptq-13b', 'summarize: ...')
print(resp.text)
```

leo: I'll make sure the CI runs that sample notebook as a smoke test.

partners-bot: Reminder: marketplace checklist updated — new required fields: `partner_logo`, `support_contact`, `signed_mou`. See /ops/marketplace-checklist.md

olivia: Perfect. Thanks everyone. We'll land PRs, confirm NDAs, and reconvene Thursday 11am.

sana: quick ques — should HW partners provide perf logs or do we run the tests in our infra?

olivia: Prefer we run in our CI using partner images to ensure consistent measurement, but accept partner-submitted logs for initial triage.

jordan: noted. will capture in runbook. :memo:

leo: thanks — filing the initial CI issue now.

mia: looping legal.

olivia: :party_parrot:
